faqs.a:
If any officer, agent or manager of the provider which is subject to the provisions
               of this article shall fail, neglect or refuse to make or file the monthly statement
               of accounts provided in
section 98-33
, the said officer, agent, manager, or person shall, upon conviction thereof, be punished
               by a fine not less than $25.00, nor more than $500.00, provided that each day after
               said statement shall become delinquent during which the said officer, agent, manager
               or person shall so fail, neglect or refuse to make and file such statement shall be
               considered a separate and distinct offense.
(Code 1981, § 31-20; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002)
